title: fix(sdk): remove n from imageGenerate
author: ale-rls
pr_body_excerpt:
Fixes #16629

- Removes `n` from `imageGenerate()`. The API generates one image per request and rejects `n` above 1, so the option could only fail.
- `imageGenerate()` now always returns one image instead of `ImageResponse | ImageResponse[]`.
- Bumps the package to 5.1.0-alpha.12, with a CHANGELOG entry.
- Verified: `npm run typecheck` and `npm test` (123/123) pass in `packages/sdk`.

_Found by Ribbert. Reworked in review: the API caps `n` at 1, so the option is removed rather than fixed._

<!-- ribbert:bug=10:97a47523 -->

gist.headline: One image, one answer
gist.blurb: The SDK stops offering an image count the API never accepted. One request, one image, one less surprise.
gist.summary: SDK 5.1.0-alpha.12 removes the unsupported `n` option from `imageGenerate()` and makes its return type consistently `ImageResponse` instead of `ImageResponse | ImageResponse[]`.
gist.impact: SDK callers get a predictable single-image result without an option that failed whenever `n` exceeded 1.
